claims.text: Hotel del Coronado is a 28-acre beachfront destination.

findings.quote: Hotel del Coronado is a 28‑acre beachfront destination

claims.text: Rooms and suites are spread across three neighborhoods: the Victorian, the Cabanas and the Views.

findings.quote: rooms and suites available in three distinct neighborhoods: the iconic Victorian, the lively Cabanas, and the contemporary Views

claims.text: The Victorian is the original beachfront hotel, established in 1888.

findings.quote: The Victorian is the original, iconic beachfront hotel established in 1888

claims.text: In the Victorian, no two rooms are alike.

findings.quote: no two rooms are alike, and all are full of character.

claims.text: Victorian rooms have a private bathroom with a walk-in shower and interior design that celebrates the Victorian era.

findings.quote: Inside, enjoy a private bathroom with walk-in shower and an interior design that celebrates the beauty of the Victorian era.

claims.text: The Views offers rooms and suites with front-row access to the Pacific.

findings.quote: The Views offers rooms and suites with front-row access to the Pacific

claims.text: Club Access rooms include daily breakfast, beach chairs and umbrella, seasonal Beach Club access and curated afternoon bites.

findings.quote: this room includes exclusive Club Access with daily breakfast, beach chairs and umbrella, seasonal Beach Club access, curated afternoon bites, and more.

claims.text: Spa & Salon at The Del blends traditional wellness practices with modern spa techniques, using natural ingredients from the land and sea.

findings.quote: Spa & Salon at The Del continues this legacy with treatments that blend traditional wellness practices with modern spa techniques using natural ingredients derived from the land and sea.

claims.text: Children can join the Ocean Explorers Kids Club, or private childcare can be arranged, while parents visit the spa.

findings.quote: Make time for the Spa with Ocean Explorers Kids Club or Private Childcare.

claims.text: Some Like It Hot was filmed at Hotel del Coronado in 1958.

findings.quote: 1958 - Some Like it Hot filmed at Hotel del Coronado

claims.text: Nobu Del Coronado has indoor and al fresco dining, with a covered patio, a pagoda bar and a dedicated sushi bar.

findings.quote: Nobu Del Coronado features indoor and al fresco dining with an outdoor covered patio, pagoda bar, and dedicated sushi bar.

claims.text: Veranda is an al fresco restaurant with ocean views.

findings.quote: A timeless al fresco dining experience with spectacular ocean views, Veranda is a journey of familiarity rediscovered.

claims.text: The original 1888 Victorian hotel is a lovingly restored National Historic Landmark.

findings.quote: The Victorian is the original, iconic beachfront hotel established in 1888
Take a journey through time in this lovingly restored National Historic Landmark.

claims.text: The Cabanas sits at the heart of the resort, with a central pool, beachfront access and fireside terraces.

findings.quote: The Cabanas places you at the heart of the resort, with a vibrant central pool, coveted beachfront access, and fireside terraces

claims.text: In the Cabanas, guests choose between a beachside room with a terrace and fire pit or a poolside room that serves as a private cabana.

findings.quote: Choose between a beachside room with a terrace and fire pit or a poolside room that serves as your private cabana

claims.text: Booking a massage, facial or body treatment includes access to the spa's relaxation lounges, spa terrace and ocean-view spa pool.

findings.quote: Enjoy exclusive access to our relaxation lounges, spa terrace, and ocean-view spa pool when you reserve a massage, facial, or body treatment.

claims.text: Experiences range from private beach bonfires with s'mores to pool cabanas and surf lessons.

findings.quote: From private beach bonfires with s’mores to plush pool cabanas and surf lessons

claims.text: Spa services are open only to guests 14 and older.

findings.quote: Young adults 14 and older are welcome to receive spa services.
